general.session_name:
- null for an automatic format like 'version_parameters'
- or type wanted-name for folder
general.search_data:
- true to make automatic query with Obspy
- fixed if want a fixed list of station
- false for data in 'Data' folder
- or dir to the folder with data
general.keep_data:
- 'all' to keep all data
- 'used' for only used signals
- null (default) remove all data for minimum space
general.saved_results:
- 'all' to save everything in files
- 'plot' to redo plots later
- 'detailed' saves all stations contribution over time
- 'minimum' for files with general results, station contribution and energy growth
- 'fastest' only write in the general results file
general.do_plot:
- 'format' (.png,.pdf, etc...) for wanted figures
- null for no figures
general.do_report:
- true to put everything in a pdf file (will overwrite other option to minimum report level)
- false if no pdf file wanted

plot.level:
- 'minimum' : energy growth and raw traces
- 'report' : 'minimum' level + map of stations deviation + results in a graphic text
- 'all' : output every possible plots
- 'personalized' : select following parameters with true or false
plot.report_details: add pages to report for explanations
plot.step:
- 'final' : plot only final results
- 'all' : also plot in between steps

details.ener_growth: evolution of energy with time on both frequency bands
details.ener_growth_corrected: corrected evolution of energy with time on both frequency bands
details.sta_ener_flux: energy growth and each station measurements
details.sta_ener_flux_deviation: presentation of station deviations and with energy flux is corrected
details.sta_map_dev: circular map of staation location and contribution for each frequency band
details.cat_region_results: Energy/moment result compared to the ccatalogue results
details.confidence_radar: radar graphic of 7 parameters evaluation and confidence level in the result
details.apparent_stress: slowness parameter variation (based on PREM rigidity) with depth compared to interpretation based on mechanism/fault maturity
details.signal_dist: selected velocity recordings coloured by distance
details.signal_az: selected velocity recordings coloured by station azimuth
details.stream_list: list of recordings metadata (id, lenth, sampling rate, starting time)

waves.network_fixed:
- true for selected network
- false if every station possible
waves.P_teleseismic:
- true for P waves from 30° (default for rt)
- false if no
waves.P_regional:
- true for P waves from 5° to 30°
- false if no
waves.S_near:
- true impedance added to p waves for s waves comparison
- false if no

time_max:
- int for maximum time p waves
- null will set a value based on travel times
time_max_s:
- int for maximum time s waves
- null will set default 60s
time_stop:
- true for an automatic time stop
- false will run the full time_max window
time_eval_method:
- 'tacer' for the time-averaged cumulative energy rate
- 'trend' for start and end trend lines
- 'both' for a joint method

distance.include_near:
-true add iteration for close S waves
 false will do only p waves
distance.totalstep: - float of how many iterations to do for p waves (min 1.0)

channel_code:
list of desired data channels among [BH,SH,HH]
- https://ds.iris.edu/ds/nodes/dmc/data/formats/seed-channel-naming/

deviation_correction.snr_keep: float accepted for maximum noise level accepted in data folder else deleted (in dB)
deviation_correction.snr_max: float accepted for minimum noise level accepted in calculation (in dB)
deviation_correction.unknown_site_class:
- null to not consider station with unknown site-class
 - 'A','B','C','D' to assign conresponding class
deviation_correction.type: - 'result' to remove deviatoric stations after energy estimation on this event ONLY
deviation_correction.threshold: float maximum deviatio accepted (in log10 of the energy)

redoing_results.force_signal:
bool to research data again if they already exists
- false by default if 'keep-data' is false
redoing_results.force_results:
bool to redo the estimation if the results already exists
- doesn't overwrite in the general results file
- if no data are saved, will perform the query
redoing_results.force_plot:
bool to redo the plots if they already exists
- if results are saved, only do the plots
- if no results exists and no data are saved, do all the those steps
